query.text: 请帮我们检查摸牌是否遵守规则，发现违规时提醒纠正。本局规则：每人每轮摸一张牌，按开局前三次摸牌的人员顺序循环。
query.text_en: Please help us check if the card drawing complies with the rules, and remind us to correct any violations. The rules for this round: each person draws one card per round, cycling in the order of the first three people who drew cards at the start.

annotation.text_zh: 黄衣男子没有按轮次摸牌，请按约定的顺序摸牌。
annotation.text_en: The man in yellow drew out of turn. Please draw cards in the agreed order.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
